heading: One move
text: Everything is a surface, and everything done here is one move: a lens takes a shape from a surface, lets through what it defines, and lays it on a surface. A place is a surface that says what it is. A chunk of data is a shape of shapes, down to ones and zeros; lenses stacked form planes, and a plane holds planes; with compositions of lenses any shape can be carved from a shape, and the composition itself shows how.

heading: Navigating
text: What is most important is not the structure alone: it is navigating in it - between composing, concrete acts answering concrete needs, and stepping back, seeing the plane one is on from the plane before, as far back as one can, which is the whole. Stepping back without losing the relations that were there in the details; going forward with the insight, to merge what overlaps and fill what is lacking, without losing them either.

heading: The whole is discovered
text: The whole is not changed but discovered: a gap is what is not yet seen in it, an overlap two things of one nature. What does not fit is a sign - stale, overlapping, lacking, unclear - answered by seeing how things fit; then it cannot arise again and nothing is left to maintain. Discovery merges; it does not pile up. A milestone is a praise - of a work done, or of a work ahead that fills a gap, merges an overlap or clarifies the whole - and the tool shows them, as intelligible data from intelligible data; they are not placed from outside, out of taste.

heading: Read off the act
text: Meanings follow from the data and from the act of working. Work is seen where it happens: traversing the relations, looking, supplying a glimpse are the concrete moments it happens. Nothing is typed to keep a state true; interacting with it is not form-filling.

heading: A process of a whole
text: It is a process of a whole, and like any process has no defined start and no end. When nothing is done it flows without load, like an open window: it shows what is, and its relations. One puts a finger into that flow - makes a connection, gives a name - and what one is working on is exactly derivable from what one does in the window: in progress is not a one-time render but a continuous reflection of observed signals.

heading: A hand that draws itself
text: The interface for navigating, composing and stepping back is made with what it makes, like a hand that draws itself. What lenses do is not left behind the brackets of an interface, in code. In the perfect system what we called handwork is made through the system itself; looked at from the topmost level, the most handwork of all is using it; and the one who works on it most stands inside it.

heading: One need: clarity
text: There is no separate test and no boundary, for there was one need - clarity. When everything is traversable, adjustable without conflict, transparent and self-explanatory, what is not the way we want is seen in its projection and adjusted: a new lens that changes the composition a little - only what is added or changed recorded, the rest referenced. There is no wrong lens to check from outside.

heading: All of it
text: All of it is taken in - everything said and done, wherever it lives. A place is not so much somewhere fixed as how to get to it and how to get what it has: lenses do that, and themselves show where its there is. And what leads to no surface lets go: branches that end in no interface dissolve, like the natural rotation of things in an ecosystem.

heading: In one's head
text: It shows, by being used, that navigating between layers is what matters, and how to hold vast detailed pictures of layers and their relations - so that a person can have the system itself in their head, and use it to navigate anything from the abstract to the concrete and back.

heading: Where it stands
text: Where it stands to this is not written here: it is read off. The sheet of the perfect form places, beside each angle, what the lenses show of it now.
